description: This file defines a React functional component named Header, which renders a header UI with a hamburger menu, branding, and theme toggle button. It manages local state for the drawer menu and references for accessibility.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: React functional component rendering the header with accessible menu and branding.

methods.name: openMenu
methods.description: Sets drawerOpen state to true to open the menu.

methods.name: closeMenu
methods.description: Closes the menu and refocuses on the hamburger button for accessibility.
